answer: Cross-epoch conduct matching scores each identity's actions against its own prior history across at least two epochs, weighting for stable timing and task mix like timber grain in a beam. Ratings route only toward agents whose past behaviour predicts their next behaviour within tolerance. A cluster split from one operator leaves an orchard of thinly rooted accounts whose patterns diverge under this test. Rebuilding the history needed to pass costs each clone a full cedar scaffold of consistent, aged output.
